name: SynTReN source network SIF
description: SynTReN source regulatory network in SIF format. Each non-empty row contains source regulator, interaction token and target gene, separated by whitespace or tabs.
example:
arcA	re	aceBAK
arcA	ac	appCBA
araC	du	araBAD
validation_notes: The first token is the upstream regulator identifier and the third token is the target gene identifier.
The second token uses SynTReN interaction labels: ac for activation, re for repression and du or other labels for unknown/dual interactions.
The wrapper must validate row arity and reject rows that cannot be parsed as three-token SIF interactions before invoking SynTReN.
